  V.transpose * V = 1 →
    A.transpose * A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal lam →
      ∀ (x : Fin n → ℝ),
        (A * V * Matrix.diagonal c * V.transpose).mulVec x ⬝ᵥ (A * V * Matrix.diagonal c * V.transpose).mulVec x =
          ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * lam i * V.transpose.mulVec x i ^ 2

  have V := ↑⋯.eigenvectorUnitary;
  OracleTemplate.Muon.toMatrix (OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize W) =
    (OracleTemplate.Muon.toMatrix W * V *
        Matrix.diagonal fun i =>
